content.text: Launching Activate deserves a visual that feels like the exact moment something switches on. Here's the story graphic.

input.prompt: A single brilliant point of light igniting at the exact center of a pure black canvas, radiating outward in soft concentric waves of pink #FE3184 through coral #FF6B35 to orange #ec7211. The core is bright and sharp like a spark of energy just triggered, with smooth gradient glow dissipating into darkness. Subtle fine particle texture and faint light rays extend vertically through the frame, suggesting motion and momentum spreading outward from the center. Premium, cinematic, minimal, lots of negative black space above and below the light burst so the composition breathes vertically. No text, no hands, no human figures, no logos. Sophisticated tech-meets-human energy, not corporate, not clip-art. Deep black background fading to near-black at the edges, no navy tones.

content.text:
![Gratitude 9:16 image](/api/resources/47089442-5f2c-4071-b055-1addf631a477/download?inline=1)

That spark igniting in the center is the moment: one choice, put into motion. Here's the copy to set on top, in Anton and Inter, inside the safe zone (clear of the top 200px username bar and bottom 280px link area):

**Label** (Inter SemiBold, 12px, uppercase, 0.1em tracking, pink #FE3184)
ACTIVATE

**Headline** (Anton 400, uppercase, ~56-64px, centered, white)
ACTIVATE IS LIVE

**Supporting line** (Inter Regular, 18-20px, white at 70% opacity)
Good is ready to happen. Choose an act, and it moves.

**CTA** (Inter SemiBold, 16px, white, sits inside a gradient pill button, pink to coral to orange)
Yes. Make this happen.

Tell me if you want a second version with a different visual mood, or a matching feed post for the same announcement.
